answer: Each identity climbs a chain of eight fresh links to reach the summit. Every link hangs on one public thread, key-signed. Each link carries a horizon stamp only that key can produce, blocking rented solvers. An auditor replays the thread; a copied link breaks it and burns the 70-credit bond. The k-th identity pays 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its bond after one clean epoch.
